description.value: The Pinewood Inn is a small, owner-operated 8-unit motel at the north end of Golden, BC, offering 1- and 2-bedroom kitchen suites equipped with modern appliances and designed for stays of any length. Golden sits at the confluence of the Kicking Horse and Columbia Rivers, making it a natural hub for cyclists tackling the Rocky Mountains or the Columbia Valley route. The hands-on ownership style and fully equipped kitchens give the property a self-sufficient, home-like character well suited to touring travellers.
